scope.eventual_scope: open ended all observed countries; same country may be donor and recipient; multilaterals typed separately

recipient_formula: 100*(1-weighted mean absolute difference of frozen normalized features)
weights: general panel equal 0.25; sector panels general context 0.5 plus sector needs 0.5
donor_formula: 100-mean absolute difference of four 0..100 GPEDC donor practice dimensions
candidate_rule: fix first selected country; exclude second selected country; require observed sector exposure in collected subset for suggestions; show additional profile matches separately if needed
missing: complete selected panel required; no mean imputation or missing as zero
ranking_tie: ISO3 stable tie-break, not substantive preference

predicted_chemistry.reason: no validated outcome training labels; schema reserves nullable field

limits: donor practice similarity is not sector specialisation
higher activity counts show experience, not success
national averages omit island and subnational logistics
no fixed PNG recommendation or donor nationality preference
2023 is common comparison year, not current state
health combines health/population/reproductive-health DAC codes; digital telecom exposure does not imply all digital capability
recommendation direction controls candidate entity; observed chemistry itself is not reversed or recalculated
